notes.title: State of the Game - December 2024
notes.notes:
Playtesting for the Beta is now open! This is a 1.0 Beta, so expect bugs and please report them to the emails mentioned in-game so we can quickly fix them! Thank you for the support! New content, bug fixes and updates are releasing every day. Also, if you have additional content ideas, feel free to reach out as well.

The current state of the game only scratches the surface of what's to come. Thank you for your support!
